description: UCI row 22 (age 48, HIGH vulnerability, none knowledge, RT 3, horizon 2yr) — money market fund: all hard rules pass (score 100) -> SUITABLE
client_narrative: Bogumił Nowak is 48 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 13,900 euros (around 1,158 euros per month). They hold 56,000 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 2,900 euros with a 2-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has no investment experience and has never purchased any financial product beyond basic bank savings accounts. Their investment approach is moderate-to-conservative — they rate their risk tolerance at 3 out of 10. They have stated they cannot afford to lose the full 2,900 euros invested. They have been assessed as financially vulnerable.
product_narrative: The product is a short-term money market fund investing exclusively in high-quality, short-duration eurozone sovereign and agency instruments rated at least A-. The fund is registered as a UCITS, listed on Euronext Amsterdam, publishes a KID, and uses no leverage or derivatives of any kind. Capital preservation is the primary objective. The recommended minimum investment period is one year.
